name: ATIS Telecom5G Property Taxonomy
description: Machine-readable conformance extract aligned to the normative ATIS telecom5g 1.0.0 human-readable taxonomy and profile.
scopeNote: 3GPP 5G cryptographic inventory baseline: TR 33.938 V19.2.0. The baseline governs the crypto inventory, not every 5G architecture vocabulary; out-of-baseline crypto constructs require explicit object-scoped provenance.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:profile
properties.description: Identifies the ATIS 5G CBOM profile and version claimed by this BOM.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:taxonomyVersion
properties.description: Identifies the ATIS telecom5g property taxonomy version used by this BOM. This version is independent of the profile version and the CycloneDX implementation-binding version.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:cbom.scope
properties.description: Declares whether the CBOM represents vendor capability or deployment-specific posture. Strict v1.0.0 conformance requires exactly one scope.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:baselineRelease
properties.description: BOM-level default 3GPP architecture/specification release for represented entities and bindings unless an object supplies 3gppSpecRelease.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:inventoryBaseline
properties.description: Specific cryptographic inventory baseline used by the profile or producer.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:inventoryCompleteness
properties.description: Producer assertion about completeness of the in-scope telecom cryptographic inventory declarations represented by this CBOM. Meaning is scope-relative; complete does not imply that absent capabilities or deployment states are unsupported/not used.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:inventoryScopeRef
properties.description: References a represented entity or reified binding bom-ref that forms an explicit root of the inventory scope. At least one scope root is required when inventoryCompleteness=complete.
properties.cardinality: MAY appear multiple times; MUST appear at least once when complete

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:scenario
properties.description: Architecture scenario target, e.g., TS23.501-roaming.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:entityType
properties.description: 3GPP 5GS entity or Network Function type represented by the CBOM. The name intentionally includes non-NF entities such as UE, gNB, and ng-eNB. Where applicable, cryptographic usage for that entity is aligned with TR 33.938.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:nfType
properties.description: Migration alias for atis:telecom5g:entityType. MUST NOT appear in a strict v1.0.0 CBOM.
properties.cardinality: MUST NOT appear in strict v1.0.0

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:3gppSpecRelease
properties.description: Object-level 3GPP release for the entity or binding; when present it explicitly overrides metadata baselineRelease for that object.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:nf.name
properties.description: Canonical NF identifier when native service/component name is not canonical. NF-scoped only; subject MUST be classified as an NF.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:nf.type
properties.description: Optional NF category, e.g., SBA, Access, UserPlane, RoamingSecurity. NF-scoped only; subject MUST be classified as an NF.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:nf.role
properties.description: Optional NF architecture role hint, e.g., control-plane, user-plane, security-edge. NF-scoped only; subject MUST be classified as an NF.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:bindingType
properties.description: Semantic kind of the modeled 5G architectural binding/interface.
properties.cardinality: MUST appear once per reified binding

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:binding
properties.description: Canonical 3GPP architectural binding/interface label, e.g., N2, N32-f, Ua, NEF-AF, or Nausf_UEAuthentication. A protocol name such as GTP-C or 5G-AKA is not itself a binding identifier.
properties.cardinality: MUST appear once per reified binding

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:interfaces
properties.description: Migration-only compatibility summary listing 3GPP reference points supported/exposed by an NF or entity. MUST NOT appear in a strict v1.0.0 CBOM.
properties.cardinality: MUST NOT appear in strict v1.0.0

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:interface
properties.description: Migration-only compatibility property for a single 3GPP reference point. MUST NOT appear in a strict v1.0.0 CBOM.
properties.cardinality: MUST NOT appear in strict v1.0.0

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:assertion
properties.description: Migration-only compatibility qualifier for a crypto statement as supported or effective. MUST NOT appear in a strict v1.0.0 CBOM.
properties.cardinality: MUST NOT appear in strict v1.0.0

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:crypto.supportedProtocols
properties.description: Vendor capability summary of canonical cryptographic protocols supported by the represented entity/product.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:crypto.supportedConstructs
properties.description: Vendor capability summary of canonical non-protocol security constructs supported by the represented entity/product.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:crypto.supportedCryptography
properties.description: Vendor capability summary using noncanonical display/index labels for cryptographic algorithms, suites, or primitives supported by the represented entity/product. Each value MUST correspond to a detailed cryptographic asset; native CycloneDX cryptoProperties are authoritative for normalized interpretation.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:securityObjective
properties.description: Security objective provided on the binding, kept distinct from operational context and cryptographic usage type.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:protectionContext
properties.description: Multi-valued faceted operational-context classification. Values from different facets (plane, layer, interface/application context, operational context) MAY coexist and are not mutually exclusive. No unqualified other value is defined.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:cryptoUsageType
properties.description: TR 33.938-aligned cryptographic feature or usage type for the represented cryptographic-asset instance. If the same algorithm has materially different usage semantics in different contexts, separate contextual asset instances with distinct bom-ref values SHOULD be used. Binding-level use is summary-only.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:protocol
properties.description: Canonical telecom-facing protocol label used by the binding.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:securityConstruct
properties.description: Canonical telecom-facing non-protocol security construct identifier. Prefer a distinct referencable construct asset when graph identity is needed.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:securityConstructType
properties.description: Canonical semantic classification of a securityConstruct on a referencable construct component. It MUST match the v1.0.0 security-construct classification table. Binding/service summaries use securityConstruct without securityConstructType.
properties.cardinality: MUST appear once per referencable security-construct component

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:cryptography
properties.description: Noncanonical display/index label for a cryptographic algorithm, suite, or primitive used by the binding. It MUST correspond to a detailed reachable cryptographic asset; native CycloneDX cryptoProperties are authoritative for normalized interpretation.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:effectiveProtocol
properties.description: Protocol known to be active, enforced, negotiated, or directly observed in the deployed binding. Mere configuration is not sufficient.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:effectiveConstruct
properties.description: Non-protocol security construct known to be active, enforced, negotiated, or directly observed in the deployed binding. Mere configuration is not sufficient.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:effectiveCryptography
properties.description: Noncanonical display/index label for an algorithm or suite known to be active, enforced, negotiated, or directly observed in the deployed binding. It MUST correspond to a detailed reachable asset; native CycloneDX cryptoProperties are authoritative for normalized interpretation.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:usageContext
properties.description: Migration-only free-form compatibility context. MUST NOT appear in a strict v1.0.0 CBOM.
properties.cardinality: MUST NOT appear in strict v1.0.0

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:cryptographyClass
properties.description: High-level class of the represented cryptographic algorithm/construction component. Allowed values are symmetric, asymmetric, hybrid, or unknown. hybrid denotes a single construction deliberately combining cryptographic schemes/classes; coexistence of symmetric and asymmetric algorithms on a protocol/binding does not make that protocol/binding hybrid. Primitive/function is represented by native CycloneDX algorithmProperties.primitive.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:keyLength
properties.description: Key size in bits when useful as a summary/fallback field. Prefer native CycloneDX fields for cryptographic assets.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:curve
properties.description: Elliptic curve identifier when useful as a summary/fallback field. Prefer native CycloneDX fields for cryptographic assets.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:cert.profile
properties.description: Certificate profile identifier/reference when native CycloneDX certificate modeling is not available.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:cert.validation
properties.description: Certificate validation mechanism summary, e.g., OCSP, CRL. Prefer native CycloneDX certificate objects where detailed data is needed.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:pki.usage
properties.description: High-level indicator that PKI/X.509 is used for the service/binding. Detailed certificate/key material should use native CycloneDX CBOM structures.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:pki.role
properties.description: High-level PKI role of the subject in scope. Authentication mode is modeled separately.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:pki.authenticationMode
properties.description: Authentication mode for PKI/X.509 use, kept distinct from PKI role. Where it describes the same subject as sbi.mutualAuthentication, the two properties MUST be consistent.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:pki.trustAnchor
properties.description: Trust anchor identifier or label when needed for operational context.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:trust.domain
properties.description: Trust domain/zone classification, e.g., access, core, inter-PLMN.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:trust.boundary
properties.description: Boolean-like indicator that the service/binding sits at a trust boundary.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:spec.primary
properties.description: Primary 3GPP specification reference when native CycloneDX externalReferences cannot be used.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:spec.crypto
properties.description: Crypto-specific specification reference when native CycloneDX externalReferences cannot be used.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:nasIntegrityAlgorithm
properties.description: NAS integrity algorithm identifier.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:nasConfidentialityAlgorithm
properties.description: NAS confidentiality algorithm identifier.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:upIntegrityAlgorithm
properties.description: User-plane integrity algorithm identifier where UP integrity is used/activated.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:suciProtectionScheme
properties.description: SUCI protection scheme used for SUPI concealment when applicable.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:sbi.mutualAuthentication
properties.description: Indicates whether mutual authentication is required/implemented for SBI.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:oauthTokenType
properties.description: NF access token type used for SBI authorization.

properties.name: atis:telecom5g:oauthTokenProtection
properties.description: Protection mechanism used for an OAuth/JWT access token in the 3GPP profile.

pattern_properties.description: Legacy compact per-interface syntax. Distinct binding services are preferred in v1.0.0.
Legacy compact per-interface certificate summary properties.

dependency_edge_absence_semantics: Absence of a CycloneDX dependsOn edge does not assert non-dependency; an edge may be omitted when generic dependency semantics would falsely assert simultaneous/conjunctive dependency for alternative, conditional, or choice relationships.

out_of_baseline_provenance.versionEvidence: The component externalReference or its comment/metadata must identify the applicable TS 33.501 release/version when available.

crypto_usage_context_semantics.scope: cryptoUsageType applies to the represented cryptographic-asset instance, not universally to the algorithm family.
crypto_usage_context_semantics.rule: When the same algorithm has materially different usage semantics in different protocol/binding contexts, use separate contextual component instances with distinct bom-ref values.
crypto_usage_context_semantics.sharedAssetAllowedWhen: The asserted cryptoUsageType set is intended to apply identically in every context that references the shared asset.

inventory_completeness_semantics.scope: inventoryCompleteness is interpreted relative to mandatory cbom.scope, explicit inventoryScopeRef roots, and declared scenario/release qualifiers; it does not claim coverage of the entire 5G System.
inventory_completeness_semantics.scopeRoots: When inventoryCompleteness=complete, at least one metadata inventoryScopeRef MUST identify a represented entity or reified binding in the same CBOM.
inventory_completeness_semantics.vendor: complete means all known positive supported-capability declarations within the explicitly declared scope roots are included.
inventory_completeness_semantics.deployed: complete means all known positive deployment-specific cryptographic declarations within the explicitly declared scope roots are included.
inventory_completeness_semantics.absence: complete never converts an absent declaration into unsupported, not configured, or not used.

scopeClosure.definition: least fixed-point closure over declared roots, dependency reachability, and summary-backed detailed assets
steps: include every object transitively reachable through CycloneDX dependencies[].dependsOn

for each included entity or reified binding, include every detailed protocol/security-construct/cryptographic asset required to back its ATIS supported, binding-level, or effective summaries even if an edge was intentionally omitted to avoid false conjunctive semantics
repeat dependency traversal and summary-backed inclusion until no additional object is added
scopeClosure.exclusion: An object is not part of the scope closure merely because it is present elsewhere in the BOM.
scopeClosure.openWorldCompatibility: Summary-backed inclusion ensures alternative/conditional assets intentionally lacking generic dependency edges remain inside the declared completeness boundary.
scopeClosure.multipleMatches: If multiple detailed objects match the same in-scope summary value and no narrower graph association identifies one backing instance, all matching objects are included.

deployment_effective_semantics.deployedScope: deployed identifies a deployment-specific CBOM and may contain configuration and effective-state information.
deployment_effective_semantics.effective: effective* is reserved for cryptography known to be active, enforced, negotiated, or directly observed in the represented deployment; mere configuration is insufficient.
deployment_effective_semantics.timestamp: A deployed CBOM that contains any effective* assertion must include CycloneDX metadata.timestamp; it is the as-of time shared by the effective assertions in that snapshot. Assertions with different as-of times should be emitted in separate snapshots.
deployment_effective_semantics.vendorRestriction: A vendor-scope CBOM must not contain effective* properties.

cryptography_class_semantics.hybrid: a single cryptographic construction deliberately combining schemes/classes; mere coexistence of symmetric and asymmetric algorithms in a protocol/binding is not hybrid

baseline_scope_semantics.inventoryBaseline: 3GPP TR 33.938 V19.2.0 is the cryptographic-inventory baseline, not the source vocabulary for every 5G architectural entity or binding.
baseline_scope_semantics.provenance: Object-scoped provenance is mandatory for protocol/security-construct entries admitted outside the cryptographic inventory baseline. Architectural entity/binding vocabularies may have their own 3GPP sources.

strict_conformance.deprecatedProperties: Deprecated ATIS properties and legacy dotted iface.* syntax are prohibited in strict v1.0.0 conformance. Migration and conversion behavior is informative and outside the normative CBOM conformance model.
strict_conformance.semanticTyping: Semantic object roles are determined by ATIS/native properties, not by bom-ref naming conventions.

cryptography_summary_semantics.rule: summary strings MUST NOT be used as canonical cross-vendor algorithm identifiers; normalized comparison uses the detailed native asset representation

duplicate_fact_consistency.authority: where an ATIS summary/fallback property and native CycloneDX represent the same fact, the native detailed representation is authoritative and the ATIS value MUST be consistent
machineChecks: pki.authenticationMode mutual is incompatible with sbi.mutualAuthentication=false
numeric keyLength on an algorithm component must match a numeric native parameterSetIdentifier
curve on an algorithm component must agree with a recognizable native curve parameterSetIdentifier
duplicate_fact_consistency.fallbackRule: when equivalence cannot be mechanically established, producers remain responsible for consistency; validators may warn or use profile-specific extensions

release_semantics.baselineRelease: BOM-level default 3GPP architecture/specification release for represented objects unless overridden
release_semantics.3gppSpecRelease: object-level explicit override of baselineRelease for that entity or binding
release_semantics.precedence: object 3gppSpecRelease overrides metadata baselineRelease for that object; differing values are not inherently contradictory

effective_snapshot_semantics.timestamp: for a CBOM containing effective* assertions, native metadata.timestamp is the as-of time of the effective-state snapshot, not merely document-generation time
effective_snapshot_semantics.multiTime: materially different effective-state times SHOULD be represented as separate snapshots until a structured evidence/time model exists

binding_association_semantics.rule: every reified binding service MUST have a bom-ref and MUST be a dependency target of at least one represented entity in the same CBOM
binding_association_semantics.endpointScope: v1.0.0 requires at least one represented entity association; it does not require both architectural endpoints

normative_language.interpretation: RFC 2119 / RFC 8174 when and only when capitalized

normative_references.CycloneDX: CycloneDX Specification 1.7 JSON serialization and official JSON schema bundle (bom-1.7.schema.json)
normative_references.3GPP_TS_33_501: 3GPP TS 33.501, Security architecture and procedures for 5G System

artifact_status_and_precedence.profile: normative; authoritative for profile-level modeling, conformance, graph, scope, and interpretation rules
artifact_status_and_precedence.humanTaxonomy: normative; authoritative for ATIS property names, controlled vocabularies, placement, and cardinality
artifact_status_and_precedence.machineTaxonomy: derived conformance artifact; MUST remain consistent with normative text and cannot weaken it
artifact_status_and_precedence.overlaySchema: derived conformance artifact; MUST remain consistent with normative text and cannot weaken it
artifact_status_and_precedence.pythonTooling: reference implementation / informative tooling; not normative and not required for conformance
artifact_status_and_precedence.conflictRule: If a publication defect creates a conflict, the normative profile and human-readable taxonomy control; the conflict MUST be reported and corrected in a subsequent version.

semantic_versioning.note: A leading v in filenames/tags is not part of the Semantic Version; 1.0.0 is the first stable release in this version line.

terms_and_definitions.architecturalBindingInterface: Named architectural connection, reference point, NF service interface, protocol-based interface, application interface, or internal interface represented by binding plus bindingType.
terms_and_definitions.effectiveState: Deployment-specific cryptographic state known active, enforced, negotiated, or directly observed at the metadata.timestamp as-of time; configuration or permission alone is not effective state.
terms_and_definitions.inventoryScopeRoot: Represented entity or reified binding whose bom-ref is named by atis:telecom5g:inventoryScopeRef.
terms_and_definitions.inventoryScopeClosure: Least fixed-point set derived from inventory scope roots under the profile scope-closure algorithm.
terms_and_definitions.reifiedBinding: CycloneDX service object used to give an architectural binding/interface bom-ref, ATIS binding properties, and graph identity; does not redefine the binding as a network service.
terms_and_definitions.strictConformance: Satisfaction of the official CycloneDX 1.7 schema plus all normative profile/human-taxonomy requirements without migration-only properties.
terms_and_definitions.summaryIndexProperty: ATIS property providing searchable/human-readable summary of detailed native CycloneDX content; it does not preserve pairwise relationships by itself.

canonical_binding_sources.NEF-AF: 3GPP TR 33.938 inventory context; 3GPP TS 29.522 NEF northbound API context; ATIS source-aligned descriptive label, not a claimed formal Nxx reference point

entity_type_sources.note: 5G-EIR is retained as a valid 5GC NF label even though it is outside the TR 33.938 V19.2.0 cryptographic inventory.

pqc_qsc_scope.assessmentRequirement: This profile does not define or require a PQC/CRQC exposure or risk assessment.
pqc_qsc_scope.externalMethodology: Any derived assessment depends on an external methodology identifying its rules, provenance, and methodology version.
pqc_qsc_scope.roadmap: Interoperable PQC/QSC posture and exposure semantics are deferred until a stable vendor-neutral assessment methodology is defined.
